# `Q-2-5` — Unclosed Emphasis

> A `_emphasized_` run opens with `_` but no closing `_` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Underscore-delimited emphasis (`_text_`) must be balanced inside
the same block. This error fires when an opening `_` appears
without a matching close before the block ends.

## Why this happens

Most often a typo: a closing underscore was forgotten, or a
literal underscore in identifier-style text (`some_value`) was
read as an emphasis opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `_` at the intended end, or — if the underscore
is part of an identifier — escape it as `\_` so the parser
treats it as a literal character:

```markdown
The variable `some_value` (no emphasis intended) or some\_value.
```

## Example

```markdown
Unfinished _emph.
```
